entrypoints.summary: Opening a blob_reader read request permits a user to specify the callback address and method; later chain processing retrieves and executes that callback.

affected_components.role: Processes configured blob-read callbacks and constructs the implicit callback Message.
Contains blob-read request creation for which the callback address and method are configured.

causal_paths.kind: user-configured callback to privileged implicit sender

code_slices.fixed: The report says the development team changed callback sending to BLOB_READER_ACTOR_ADDR in PR #500 and PR #515; patch content is not present in this bundle.
code_slices.surrounding_context: The report describes a path from blob_reader read-request creation, through get_open_read_requests and read_request_callback, to execution of the request return value.
code_slices.vulnerable: create_implicit_message constructs Message { from: system::SYSTEM_ACTOR_ADDR, to, method_num, params, ... }.

negative_controls: A target whose parameter decoding rejects the single Vec<u8> callback payload.
A callback dispatched from BLOB_READER_ACTOR_ADDR rather than SYSTEM_ACTOR_ADDR.
observability.positive_marker: An eligible callback target passes a SYSTEM_ACTOR immediate-caller check despite being selected by a blob-read requester.

preconditions: The attacker can open a blob-reader read request and choose its callback address and method.
The selected target function accepts a single Vec<u8> parameter representing blob content; otherwise decoding may fail.
The target relies on immediate-caller validation against SYSTEM_ACTOR_ADDR.

trigger_steps.payload_shape: A configured callback address and method; the delivered callback parameter is one Vec<u8> containing read blob content.
trigger_steps.summary: Open a blob-read request selecting a callback address and method for an eligible SYSTEM_ACTOR-restricted target.

trigger_steps.payload_shape: Implicit callback Message with the report-shown sender set to SYSTEM_ACTOR_ADDR.
trigger_steps.summary: Allow chain processing to retrieve and execute the configured callback as an implicit message.

capabilities.concept: SYSTEM_ACTOR authority inheritance by blob-read callback

relation_candidates.dst: SYSTEM_ACTOR authority inheritance by blob-read callback
relation_candidates.rationale: The report states that a requester selects callback address and method, while callback dispatch is constructed with SYSTEM_ACTOR_ADDR as sender.
The report states that SYSTEM_ACTOR-only immediate-caller checks can be circumvented through the callback, subject to the Vec<u8> parameter compatibility condition.
relation_candidates.src: SYSTEM_ACTOR authority inheritance by blob-read callback

relation_candidates.rationale: The reported resolution changes callback sending authority to BLOB_READER_ACTOR_ADDR, removing SYSTEM_ACTOR sender identity from the callback path.
relation_candidates.src: SYSTEM_ACTOR authority inheritance by blob-read callback

impact.affected_asset: Authorization boundary protecting actor functions that validate the immediate caller as SYSTEM_ACTOR_ADDR.
impact.attacker_capability: Invoke an eligible SYSTEM_ACTOR-restricted callback target through a blob-read callback, subject to that target accepting the callback's single Vec<u8> parameter.
impact.security_effect: Conditional bypass of immediate-caller access control restricted to SYSTEM_ACTOR_ADDR.

causal_trace.summary: A user opening a blob read request controls its callback address and method.
Processing open requests fetches the configured callback, but the implicit callback message assigns its sender to SYSTEM_ACTOR_ADDR rather than an unprivileged callback identity.
create_implicit_message constructs the callback Message with from set to system::SYSTEM_ACTOR_ADDR.

A selected callback target that accepts the single Vec<u8> blob-content parameter can observe SYSTEM_ACTOR as its immediate caller and thereby satisfy SYSTEM_ACTOR-only caller checks, circumventing that access control.

failure.operation: Construction of an implicit callback Message whose from field is system::SYSTEM_ACTOR_ADDR in create_implicit_message.

primary_invariant.statement: A callback selected in a user-created blob-read request must not execute with SYSTEM_ACTOR authority.
primary_invariant.violated_because: The implicit-message constructor stamps every such callback with SYSTEM_ACTOR_ADDR as its from address, even though the callback address and method are user-selected.

quality.review_notes: The primary audit report provides the request-to-callback authority chain, code excerpt, and reported remediation, but this bundle contains no implementation patch, source tree, test, transaction trace, or observed execution. The report notes a material compatibility condition: the target callback must accept one Vec<u8> parameter; it does not enumerate eligible SYSTEM_ACTOR-only methods.

remediation.invariant_restored: Blob-read callbacks execute with BLOB_READER_ACTOR_ADDR rather than SYSTEM_ACTOR_ADDR, so user-selected callback dispatch does not inherit system-only caller authority.
mitigation_classes: separate callback sender identity from system authority
send blob-read callbacks from an unprivileged actor address

affected_versions_or_commits.value: Report v2.2 at public-audits commit 48f7de362df66942a77e1dd5954b580f28ed367f; the report does not identify an affected implementation commit or release.

target.component: blob_reader actor callbacks and chain interpreter implicit-message construction
